cayley_status.available: 13 Cayley volume-level slice readers are front-facing, compiled from 126 repaired/retyped source ranges, 3289 pages total.
cayley_status.broad_volume_drafts: Full per-volume working drafts are preserved in the artifact ZIP, but are not promoted as clean top-level readers.
cayley_status.chunk_level_note: The artifact ZIP also preserves the sources_tex_Vol_I through sources_tex_Vol_XIII chunk trees. Those contain 292 TeX chunks and 155 separately rendered slice PDFs (4240 pages), including the targeted repaired/retyped ranges.
cayley_status.reason_for_replacement: Earlier broad Cayley drafts remain useful for continuation but are not as reliable as the promoted repaired slices.
